title: Lab 2A — private Fargate (part 2)
topic: ECS Fargate awsvpc networking, execution vs task role, private subnet RunTask, troubleshooting
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-10-lab-fargate-run.sh. Answer without peeking at night-10-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×3 D×2 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: You run ecs:RunTask with assignPublicIp DISABLED in private subnets. The task stays PENDING then stops with CannotPullContainerError. The Fargate security group allows egress TCP 443 only. What should you verify first?

options.A: Add an inbound rule on the Fargate SG for ECR traffic on port 443
options.B: Move the task to a public subnet with assignPublicIp set ENABLED
options.C: Private route table 0.0.0.0/0 → NAT and confirm the NAT is available
options.D: Attach an Internet Gateway directly onto the private subnet itself

questions.question: A Fargate task definition lists both an executionRoleArn and a taskRoleArn. Which role must allow ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and image layer pulls before the container starts?

options.A: Task role — the running application pulls its own container image
options.B: Execution role — the ECS agent pulls the image for the task start
options.C: GitHub Actions deploy user — only CI/CD may touch ECR repositories
options.D: ECS service-linked role for the cluster — replaces both task roles

questions.question: A batch container starts and pulls its image successfully but fails when uploading pipeline output to S3. Which IAM principal needs s3:PutObject on the bucket?

options.A: Execution role — all runtime AWS API calls use it exclusively
options.B: NAT Gateway service-linked role for private subnet SNAT mapping
options.C: CloudWatch Logs service role writing awslogs streams exclusively
options.D: Task role — application code uses task credentials for S3 writes

questions.question: Task logConfiguration uses awslogs. The task stops with ResourceInitializationError mentioning CloudWatch Logs. The execution role has AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy. What is the most likely remaining issue?

options.A: Network path to Logs endpoints via NAT or a logs VPC endpoint
options.B: Task role must include logs:CreateLogGroup for the awslogs driver
options.C: Security group needs inbound UDP 514 for classic syslog traffic
options.D: Fargate tasks cannot use awslogs when placed in private subnets

questions.question: A VPC has no S3 gateway endpoint. A Fargate task in private subnets with NAT writes large objects to S3 in the same Region. How does that S3 traffic leave the VPC?

options.A: Stays on the VPC local route — S3 is always privately routed traffic
options.B: Uses a DynamoDB gateway endpoint that covers S3 API calls as well
options.C: Goes via NAT Gateway to the S3 public endpoint (NAT charges apply)
options.D: Is blocked unless inbound 443 is added to the task security group

questions.question: You want zero NAT traffic for both ECR image pulls and S3 uploads from private Fargate tasks. Which minimum endpoint set meets that goal?

options.A: S3 gateway endpoint alone — covers ECR image layers and the API
options.B: Single interface endpoint for com.amazonaws.region.ecr.api only
options.C: Interface endpoints for ecr.api and ecr.dkr plus an S3 gateway
options.D: Internet Gateway route added to the private subnet route table

questions.question: A colleague argues the Fargate SG is wrong because there are no inbound rules and the task cannot receive responses from ECR. What is the correct response?

options.A: Add inbound 443 from the NAT Gateway security group explicitly
options.B: Security groups are stateful — return traffic for outbound is allowed
options.C: Fargate requires inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 for TLS handshakes
options.D: Disable the security group entirely for private Fargate task ENIs

questions.question: A Fargate task ENI is created in a private subnet with assignPublicIp DISABLED and outbound via NAT. Can a user on the public internet SSH to the task's private IP through the NAT Gateway?

options.A: Yes — NAT forwards inbound connections to matching private IP hosts
options.B: Yes — if the execution role includes ssm:StartSession permission
options.C: Yes — after adding an IGW route to the private subnet route table
options.D: No — NAT provides outbound-only internet access for private hosts

questions.question: A CI principal calls ecs:RunTask and must pass execution and task role ARNs. Why is iam:PassRole required?

options.A: ECS must assume those roles when starting the task on your behalf
options.B: PassRole lets the CI runner clone the ECR repository onto disk
options.C: PassRole replaces the need for a task security group on awsvpc
options.D: PassRole applies only to EC2 launch type and never to Fargate

questions.question: After a private Fargate batch RunTask completes successfully, which pair of checks best validates end-to-end success besides a zero exit code?

options.A: CloudWatch awslogs stream for the task and new objects in output
options.B: NAT Gateway deleted and Internet Gateway detached from the VPC
options.C: Task ENI received a public Elastic IP from the subnet address pool
options.D: Fargate security group shows inbound allow rules from 0.0.0.0/0
